title: Implement model-attempt authority contract
description: Harden the supported optional model-attempt authority contract: terminal unknown outcomes, replay-stable logical-call identity, post-contact non-retryable settlement behavior, and physical provider request input-token enforcement. Add outside-in regression coverage and focused validation. Policy, pricing, persistence, and product integrations are out of scope.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Started test-first implementation. Scope is an optional host model-attempt authority with durable identity/envelopes and runtime-to-agent propagation; pricing, GraphQL, and Plexus persistence remain out of scope. I will add outside-in no-contact/replay/unknown-outcome coverage before production changes.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Red/green evidence: new outside-in authority suite first failed at collection because the contract module was absent; it now passes. Focused regression run is green: 134 tests across DSPy execution/hooks/handle and runtime agent setup/enhancement. Contract now sends immutable plan/reservation/outcome/usage envelopes to an optional host authority before every Agent physical dispatch, rejects before contact, replays stored results, settles real usage/provider response IDs when available, and treats post-contact failures as outcome_unknown without automatic retry. Direct LiteLLM retries are disabled while authority is active. Remaining validation: inspect final diff and run the selected focused suite once more.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Continuing implementation: completed the local authority envelopes and runtime-to-agent propagation; now hardening broker retry forwarding so authority mode suppresses lower-layer retries across all transports. No provider calls, persistence, pricing, or commits planned.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implementation and focused verification complete. Added optional host model-attempt authority envelopes and runtime-to-agent propagation, provider-attempt reservation/settlement, no-contact reject/replay behavior, outcome-unknown protection after provider contact, local caps, and broker num_retries=0 forwarding across asyncio, AnyIO, and UDS handlers. Verification: poetry run pytest [authority, agent/runtime, broker focused targets] -q => 245 passed in 1.73s; ruff, black --check, and git diff --check passed. No provider/cloud calls, pricing policy, GraphQL or persistence work, commit, push, or task closure.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Started P1 hardening with test-first coverage. Scope is runtime/agent authority behavior only; no client data, provider calls, pricing, persistence, commits, or deployment. The tracker hierarchy rejects a task parented directly to a story, so I retained the existing valid parent.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: P1 hardening implemented and verified locally (not closed: caller prohibited commit/push). Red first: 5 authority regressions failed for streaming fallback, settlement retry, replay identity, configured-ID collision, and input overflow. Green: focused authority suite 12 passed; focused authority/streaming/agent/runtime/retry/broker suite 320 passed. Added replay-stable identity derived from procedure/run/checkpoint state with configured ID only as namespace; reject unmeasurable or collision cases before contact. Raw provider payload is measured with LiteLLM token_counter before reserve/contact; overflow and unavailable exact payload fail closed. After contact, event/settlement failures produce non-retryable outcome_unknown with best-effort conservative settlement. Ruff, Black check, and git diff --check passed. No provider calls, pricing/persistence/product imports, commits, pushes, releases, or deployments.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Follow-up validation caught the normal Raw agent wrapper shape (LuaCallableModule -> TactusModule -> RawModule) during preflight. Fixed the supported unwrapping so the authority measures RawModule.build_provider_request, not the wrapper; the overflow regression now exercises the real Raw serialized request. Re-ran the full focused set: 320 passed; Ruff, Black check, and diff check remain green.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Independent re-review found three remaining P1 blockers. Starting test-first fixes for host-visible same-scope replay, distinct stable agent identities, exact provider-payload request hashing/reuse, and terminal unknown handling for first-chunk observer failures. No client data, external-child-wait work, provider calls, commits, pushes, releases, or deployments.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Second P1 re-review fixes complete locally; task remains in_progress because commit/push were prohibited. Red evidence: 4 new reproductions failed while the previous 12 passed (same-handle replay blocked, cross-agent ID collision, tool_choice-insensitive request hash, first-chunk observer RuntimeError). Green: authority suite 18 passed after adding exact-request reuse and real Raw dispatch proofs; full authority/streaming/module/runtime/retry/broker/execution-context set 750 passed. Identity is SHA-256 of procedure/run/checkpoint + stable agent name + optional configured namespace + first exact provider-request hash; local seen-ID suppression was removed so host replay is authoritative. Each attempt builds one exact Raw request used for token counting, request_hash, and contact; repair attempts retain call_id but carry their own request_hash. Any post-contact stream observer/log/lifecycle failure is terminal ModelAttemptOutcomeUnknown with conservative settlement. Ruff, Black check, and diff check pass. No provider/cloud calls, pricing/product imports, commits, pushes, releases, deployments, or external-child-wait edits.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Cross-repo audit found a durable replay gap: succeeded outcomes do not expose persistence-safe provider results. Starting test-first support for a versioned host-neutral JSON replay envelope, exact internal result restoration, corrupted/type-mismatched fail-closed behavior, and post-contact serialization/settlement unknown handling across streaming and non-streaming. No client data, pricing/persistence/product policy, provider calls, commits, pushes, releases, deployments, or unrelated edits.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Durable replay contract gap fixed locally; task remains in_progress because commit/push were prohibited. Red: 8 new replay-contract failures while prior 18 authority tests passed. Green: authority suite 28 passed; full prior focused authority/streaming/module/runtime/retry/broker/execution-context set plus new tests 760 passed. Added ModelAttemptReplayPayload v1 as a plain JSON-compatible host-neutral envelope on succeeded outcomes and replay reservations. Agent serializes the actual DSPy Prediction, preserves typed ToolCalls, usage, provider request ID, plan/request hash, and restores a fresh Prediction without provider contact. Invalid version/kind/shape/type fails closed before contact; non-serializable provider results or settlement failure after contact become nonretryable outcome_unknown. Streaming and non-streaming persistence round trips pass. Ruff, Black check, and diff check pass. No pricing/persistence/Plexus imports, provider/cloud calls, commits, pushes, releases, deployments, or unrelated edits.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Bounded ModelAttemptAuthority documentation complete; task remains in_progress because commit/push/release were prohibited. Added a dedicated host contract covering required bounds, exact one-time Raw request build/hash/token enforcement, reserve-before-contact lifecycle, replay-stable identity, decisions/outcomes, JSON replay payload v1, post-contact unknown handling, lower-layer retry suppression, and host persistence/reconciliation responsibilities.
